purpose: Slicer module that runs the CADS nnU-Net models to segment 167 anatomical structures in whole-body CT. It installs the CADS Python package and its dependencies on first use, runs inference in a subprocess, and imports the results as segmentations with SNOMED terminology.
summary: I read the full module source, both CMakeLists files, the licenses and the README. I found no malicious behaviour, telemetry or credential access. The CMake files, the catalog entry and the CADS source download (a commit-pinned GitHub zip) all look consistent. The main concern is the environment. On Apply, the module pip-installs exact pins (numpy==1.26.4, scikit-image==0.22.0) into Slicer's shared Python, with no confirmation and no downgrade check. It also installs the CADS requirements, which I could not see, with no hash verification. The model weights are CC BY-NC-SA, non-commercial only, and the UI does not tell users that. The tests would fail in CI.
